title: Quiet the Orok Outpost
description: Quiet the Orok Outpost — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Hogarth world.dungeon01.npc.QuestGiver_L01_B

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Locate the Orok Outpost, speak with the leader, and deliver the Orok Lease Agreement to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Quest Reward: None listed in the client files

Return to: Soldier Hogarth world.dungeon01.npc.QuestGiver_L01_B

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Orok Fire Sale

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Locate the Orok Outpost, speak with the leader, and deliver the Orok Lease Agreement to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

I've been able to find out a little more information. It seems the Whiskers have been keeping the Oroks awake at night with all the extra mining racket. And then there is that smell. It.. it's hard to describe. Have you ever been offered one of Audrey's experimental creations? You know how it smells? OK, take that and then light it on fire. That's pretty much what the Fizz Rock operations smell like.

Anyway, the Oroks came to Algernon to protest and we are pretty sure they are squatting the Outpost. They can complain all they want about that unbelieveably awful smell and all the noise, but they can't do it without paying rent to Townston.

I need you to find the Orok Outpost (Hint: It's right over there.), speak with their leader, and get a copy of whatever Lease they think they have. Then bring the Lease to the Townston Commander and see if it is legit.

By the way, I hear that the leader becomes really talkative if you use a sword.

Really? You can't smell that?

Turn-in:

I see you had words with the Orok leader - it looks like you still have some words on your armor. Eww.

So why don't we see the terms of their Lease Agreement?

Objectives:

  • Locate Orok Outpost
  • ''Speak'' with Orok Leader
  • Orok Lease Agreement ×1

Client level range: 3–20
